data.name: Daman
data.gender_notes: Daman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘d-m-n’, meaning ‘to be firm and steadfast’. In Islamic contexts, Daman signifies a person of strong faith and unwavering commitment to their beliefs. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his steadfastness. The name Daman carries the meaning “Faithful, Steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daman usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of unwavering faith and commitment to God
data.etymology: Daman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daman total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Daman ibn Abbas was a young boy at the time of the Prophet's migration to Medina, and though too young to participate in battles, he showed admirable courage and steadfastness in his support for the fledgling Muslim community. His life story represents the importance of being a resilient and unwavering ally to the Islamic cause.
